title: Listing Highlight: 101' Hargrave 2016
description: Explore the 2016 Hargrave 101 Yacht, where exquisite craftsmanship meets innovative design, offering unparalleled luxury and performance on the seas.
html:
The 2016 Hargrave 101 Yacht represents a blend of meticulous craftsmanship and innovative design, offering an experience that caters to both seasoned mariners and newcomers alike. This vessel stands as a testament to Hargrave’s commitment to quality and attention to detail, making it a noteworthy option for those seeking a refined maritime experience.

The 2016 Hargrave 101 Yacht is a vessel that combines functionality with style, spanning 101 feet in length. It is designed to offer a seamless blend of comfort and performance, making it suitable for extended voyages or leisurely coastal cruising. The yacht’s layout is thoughtfully arranged to maximize space and ensure ease of movement throughout, accommodating up to eight guests in four well-appointed staterooms.

Exterior Design and Deck Features

The exterior of the Hargrave 101 is marked by sleek lines and a modern profile, reflecting contemporary design trends. The expansive deck areas provide ample space for relaxation and entertainment, featuring a spacious flybridge equipped with a wet bar and seating arrangements ideal for social gatherings. The aft deck offers a shaded dining area, while the foredeck includes sun pads for lounging, ensuring that every outdoor preference is catered to.

Luxurious Interior and Living Spaces

Inside, the Hargrave 101 offers a welcoming environment with its open-plan salon and dining area, characterized by high-quality materials and finishes. Large windows allow natural light to flood the interior, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. The galley is fully equipped to meet the needs of any culinary endeavor, and the staterooms are designed to provide privacy and comfort, each with en-suite facilities and ample storage.

Engine Performance and Technical Specs

Powered by twin Caterpillar C32 engines, the Hargrave 101 delivers reliable performance with a cruising speed of 20 knots and a maximum speed of 24 knots. The yacht’s engineering is designed to ensure smooth and efficient operation, supported by advanced stabilization systems that enhance comfort underway. With a fuel capacity of 4,500 gallons, the yacht is well-suited for long-range cruising.

Advanced Navigation and Safety Systems

The Hargrave 101 is equipped with state-of-the-art navigation and safety systems, providing peace of mind to those on board. The bridge features advanced electronics, including radar, GPS, and autopilot systems, ensuring precise navigation. Safety is prioritized with the inclusion of life rafts, fire suppression systems, and comprehensive monitoring equipment, all of which contribute to a secure maritime experience.

Summary of the Hargrave 101’s Unique Offerings

The 2016 Hargrave 101 stands out for its combination of thoughtful design, performance capabilities, and attention to detail. It offers a balanced mix of outdoor and indoor spaces, advanced technology, and reliable engineering, making it a compelling choice for those seeking a yacht that delivers on all fronts. Its ability to cater to a variety of preferences and needs makes it a versatile option for discerning buyers.

With a recent $400,000 price reduction, the Hargrave 101 Yacht is a prime opportunity for a vessel that embodies quality and thoughtful design, promising a rewarding experience on the water.
